name: omc-launcher
description: A pane opened with /omc that steps through running an oh-my-claudecode workflow: pick a skill (main workflows first), fill one field per flag parsed from its argument-hint, review the exact command line, and run it through $.command.run as though you had typed it. Writes nothing; /omc is offered whenever OMC is installed, and lists the OMC skills the session can run when it opens.
